interpretation: Retrospective comparison on a common pre-calibrated corpus. Calibration uses years beyond training. Model preprocessing itself fits training years only. This affects both AE and hybrid; it does not establish an unbiased external test or quantify ranking bias.
required_for_strict_temporal_holdout: Rebuild upstream calibration from training-period inputs only or use documented fixed external scales, then retrain, reselect on validation and evaluate once on untouched years. Rounded sidecar scale factors cannot reliably undo clipping or reconstruct raw site inputs.
